display_long_description:
# CAST REAL MAGIC WITH YOUR BARE HANDS - VR ACTION RPG

Feel magic flow through your HANDS as you cast 30+ spells using natural gestures. No buttons - just you and devastating sorcery.

Cradle fireballs in your palms and hurl them. Shoot lightning from your fingertips. Raise zombies and walls of fire. This is ICONIC spell casting that feels visceral and real. Upgrade from magic bolts to screen-filling devastation. Master fire, lightning, ice, necromancy, and more.

[media]

# A VR FIRST - OBLITERATE 200+ ENEMIES AT ONCE
[media]
Stand your ground as massive swarms filling your vision. Enemies vary in size, speed, and resistances. Magic and Rare monsters roll random buffs making every encounter unique.

Fireballs devastate orcs but miss high flyers. Lightning chains clear grunts but expose you to shamans. Hone your combat prowess and test your mental and physical abilities to the fullest.


# BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE WIZARD

Become a Fiery Mage incinerating everything, a Necromancer commanding undead, an Ice Sorceress freezing all, or create your own Hybrid Build - YOUR CHOICE. Hundreds of upgrades in the Skillarium, Rings, and Tinker Table crafting make every build different.

[media]

# DEFEAT TOWERING TITANS

Epic boss battles. In Early Access, Rajel the Inferno Titan awaits. Can you vanquish him and his brethren and obtain the **Cosmic Heart**?

[media]
